amberFrost.name: Amber Frost
amberFrost.vibe: Hot, soft, slightly smoky. Luxurious and not sweet.
amberFrost.description: Amber Frost envelops you in soft winter warmth. Bright clementine and spiced cardamom open on a smoky tea accord, leading to a heart of radiant golden amber and fine incense entwined with sambac jasmine. The drydown reveals creamy Madagascan vanilla and sandalwood with clean musk and a whisper of leather. Luxurious yet never cloying, this unisex blend captures the essence of cozy elegance.
amberFrost.middleNotes: Golden Amber, Delicate Incense, Jasmine Sambac
amberFrost.baseNotes: Madagascan Vanilla, Sandalwood, Clean Musk, Skin Touch
amberFrost.oilRecommendation: Oil recommended for deeper, longer wear
amberFrost.emotionalDescription: This fragrance mirrors your quiet confidence — warm, elegant, and present without effort. Perfect for those who value refined comfort and understated luxury.
amberFrost.howToWear: Ideal for daily wear and evening moments. Best in cold weather. Apply to pulse points for balanced projection. Pairs beautifully with warm, cozy layers.

northernIron.name: Northern Iron
northernIron.vibe: Dark, dry, forceful. A man of winter.
northernIron.description: Northern Iron is a tribute to rugged winter masculinity. It blasts off with sharp black pepper and aromatic juniper, settling into a smoked heart of vetiver, sage, and cedarwood. The base is powerful and dry – earthy patchouli, grey amber, and raw leather layers intertwine. Dark and authoritative, this bold scent embodies strength and sophistication in the cold.
northernIron.baseNotes: Dry Patchouli, Gray Amber, Rough Skin
northernIron.emotionalDescription: Your strength speaks through this bold, authoritative scent — powerful and unapologetic. For those who command attention with quiet confidence.
northernIron.howToWear: Perfect for evening and special occasions. Ideal for winter. Apply sparingly to pulse points. Creates a strong, memorable trail.

deepEmber.name: Deep Ember
deepEmber.vibe: Warm, spicy and deep. Elegant and moderately heavy.
deepEmber.description: Deep Ember offers a warm, spicy embrace. The top notes of cinnamon, clove, and bitter orange are rich and heady, giving way to a heart of dark lavender and decadent sweet tobacco set among whispering cashmere woods. Finally, a base of tonka bean, frankincense, and a hint of light oud lingers, creating an elegantly weighty dry-down. This is a bold, sophisticated scent for the modern gentleman.
deepEmber.middleNotes: Sweet Tobacco, Dark Lavender, Cashmere Trees
deepEmber.oilRecommendation: Oil recommended for deeper, more intimate wear
deepEmber.emotionalDescription: Your depth finds its match in this rich, evolving warmth — thoughtful and enveloping. For those who appreciate complexity and sophistication.
deepEmber.howToWear: Best for evening and special moments. Perfect for winter. Evolves beautifully on the skin. Layer with warm, textured fabrics.

velvetSnow.name: Velvet Snow
velvetSnow.vibe: Soft, creamy and pampering. Wrapped feminine winter.
velvetSnow.description: Velvet Snow is a soft winter reverie. Crisp pear and bergamot open the fragrance with a sparkling coolness. At its heart lies a bouquet of lush Turkish rose and rare white orchid, offering a creamy floral warmth. The base notes – smooth vanilla, soft musk, and creamy sandalwood – feel like cashmere at dusk. Gentle and enveloping, this scent wraps the wearer in a feminine embrace.
velvetSnow.oilRecommendation: Oil recommended for closer, longer-lasting wear
velvetSnow.emotionalDescription: Your softness and grace are reflected here — gentle, beautiful, and refined. For those who value comfort, beauty, and understated elegance.
velvetSnow.howToWear: Perfect for daily wear and evening moments. Ideal for winter. Apply to pulse points for intimate projection. Complements soft, luxurious fabrics.

crimsonNight.name: Crimson Night
crimsonNight.vibe: Sensual, warm, dark fruit. Winter nights.
crimsonNight.description: Crimson Night exudes sensual, dark fruit allure. It bursts open with juicy pomegranate and a playful hint of pink pepper, leading into a rich floral-fruity heart of thick jasmine, opulent black plum, and sweet ylang-ylang. The base is deep and resinous – sweet patchouli, dark amber, and a blend of deep resins – leaving a warm, enchanting trail. This is an evening fragrance for the confident, alluring woman.
crimsonNight.baseNotes: Sweet Patchouli, Dark Amber, Winter Resins
crimsonNight.oilRecommendation: Oil recommended for deeper, more sensual wear
crimsonNight.emotionalDescription: Your mysterious allure finds its voice — seductive, confident, and unforgettable. For those who embrace their power and sensuality.
crimsonNight.howToWear: Perfect for evening and night. Ideal for winter. Apply to pulse points for a memorable trail. Complements dark, elegant evening wear.

oudMirage.name: Oud Mirage
oudMirage.vibe: Clean, woody, smoky-elegant oud. Deep and impressive.
oudMirage.description: Oud Mirage is an elegant, smoky-woody journey. Soft cinnamon and warming cardamom swirl with bitter orange at the top, giving a gentle spice. The heart unfolds with clean Cambodian oud, dry Damask rose petals, and floating wisps of white incense. In the base, dark amber, Lebanese cedar, and a touch of tonka bean meet dry musk, creating an impressive and refined dry-down. This unisex scent feels like a mysterious desert dusk.
oudMirage.middleNotes: Clean Cambodian Oud, Dry Damask Rose, White Incense
oudMirage.baseNotes: Dark Amber, Lebanon Cedar, Light Tonka, Dry Musk
oudMirage.oilRecommendation: Oil recommended for deeper, more intimate oud experience
oudMirage.emotionalDescription: Your thoughtful complexity is captured here — sophisticated, enigmatic, and deeply personal. For those drawn to the exotic and mysterious.
oudMirage.howToWear: Versatile for day and evening. Works in all seasons. Apply to pulse points. Evolves beautifully over time. Complements both casual and formal wear.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does custom fragrance design work?
faq.a1: Our custom fragrance process begins with a personalized consultation to understand your preferences and personality. Our master perfumers then craft a unique blend tailored specifically to you, using rare and high-quality ingredients sourced from around the world. The result is a one-of-a-kind fragrance that tells your story.
faq.a2: Our luxury dupes are inspired by famous luxury fragrances, offering similar scent profiles at a more accessible price point. They are not exact copies but carefully crafted inspirations that capture the essence and character of the original, allowing you to experience luxury without compromise.
faq.q3: How do I take the quiz?
faq.a3: Simply click 'Begin Your Journey' on our homepage or visit the Custom Creations section. Answer a few questions about your preferences and style, and we'll recommend the perfect fragrance that speaks to your unique essence.
faq.a4: We accept PayPal, Bit, and Cash on Delivery. Payment details will be confirmed upon order placement, ensuring a seamless and secure transaction.
faq.a5: We offer free local delivery in Northern Israel (Emek Yizrael area) and free shipping on orders over ₪500. Standard shipping rates apply elsewhere, with careful packaging to preserve the integrity of your luxury fragrances.

tips.title: Fragrance Tips
tips.tip1: Store perfumes away from light and heat for longevity. Keep them in a cool, dark place to preserve their exquisite character.
tips.tip2: Apply to pulse points for the best projection. The warmth of these areas helps the fragrance unfold beautifully throughout the day.
tips.tip3: Layer scents by using matching body products. Create a harmonious fragrance experience that lingers elegantly.
tips.tip4: Let the fragrance develop on your skin for 30 minutes before judging. True luxury reveals itself gradually, like a story unfolding.

about.title: About Divina Maison
about.story1: Divina Maison was born from a passion for perfumery and the belief that everyone deserves a signature scent. Each fragrance is crafted in small batches by master perfumers, using rare ingredients to evoke emotion and create lasting memories.
about.story2: We believe in the power of scent to tell stories, express identity, and transform moments into cherished memories. Our commitment to quality and craftsmanship ensures that every bottle represents not just a fragrance, but a personal journey of discovery and elegance.
